title: Cage n(6,9): a 6-regular graph of girth 9 with few vertices
statement: Find a 6-regular simple graph whose girth (shortest cycle) is at least 9, with as few vertices n as possible; it shows n(6,9) <= n (cages grow with the girth). The best known (6,9)-graph in the House of Graphs cage table has 3422 vertices [T26]; a graph with fewer vertices improves it.
submission: Text file: one graph in graph6 or sparse6 (as House of Graphs gives them; an optional >>graph6<< or >>sparse6<< header is allowed), or an edge list, one edge "u v" per line, vertices numbered from 0.
score: n, the number of vertices of a 6-regular graph of girth at least 9 (smaller is better)
